shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A woman in a blue shirt sits at the pinboard-side window seat and defines basic proficiency as true accomplishment, while a man in a yellow shirt sits at the entrance-side window seat and a woman in a purple shirt sits at the pinboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.

shots.content: The man in a yellow shirt argues to the woman in a blue shirt that true accomplishment requires rare mastery and rigorous knowledge.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a blue shirt replies to the man in a yellow shirt that such an extreme standard makes accomplishment nearly impossible.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the worktable, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat in frame.
